d:
This video shows the real village lifestyle in Bihar, India through my first experience in a Bihar village.
It is a Bihar village life vlog that captures Indian village life Bihar, simple living, farming culture and daily routine of rural people.
In this vlog, you will see Bihar ka village life, Bihari village life, and how village life in Bihar India is deeply connected with nature.
From handpump water, farming fields, village roads to local markets, this video presents the true Indian village lifestyle and village lifestyle in Bihar India.
